title: The lane pick ignores the owner's 3 and 3 lane split
what: The split is a project setting (projects.toml or kit.toml: lanes for features, default 0, bound 0..lanes; relay 3), read by the lane pick: while fewer than that many feature lanes run, the next free lane goes to the top startable feature; the lanes line names the split ("3 of 3 fix lanes, 2 of 3 feature lanes").
why: Owner, 29 Oct: "a" = 3 lanes for relay's development (product features, the container gate kept on top) and 3 for fixes (handover addendum of 29 Oct). The decision lives only in the handover; the lane pick (lib/relay_lanes.py) orders fixes first and offers no feature while a fix can start, so on 30 Oct the front filled 6 of 6 lanes with fixes and asked the owner a question the decision already answered.
failing_case: 30 Oct 2026: with 6 lanes all on fixes and feature build-time-gates-on-the-vps-landing-gate-on-the (ip 90) startable, the hook's pick named only fixes; the owner had to recall the decision.
pass_cases: With the setting at 3 and 3 fix lanes running, a free lane is offered to the top feature, not a fix.
With the setting at 0, the pick is as today.
The lanes line shows both counts.

said: a, разве мы не приняли решение 3 на 3 ?
